channel_findings.constants: In the paper format: cream graph-paper ground on 11 of 11; a two-line headline where line 1 is black heavy condensed caps (Anton or Impact class, slightly distressed) and line 2 is cream caps inside a red brush-stroke box; one diagram drawn as if by hand (pencil labels, thin black line, watercolour fill); one red circle or red arrow marking the exact spot. Only three colours carry meaning: cream, black, red.
channel_findings.host_treatment: Same woman on 13 of 20 (all 11 paper thumbnails plus the 2 dark ones). Cut out, soft even studio light, no glow or outline. Head and shoulders, face about 30 to 40 % of frame width, usually on the right third. Plain solid top that changes colour per video (navy, black, plum, red, denim, grey). Lapel microphone visible, which sells her as a real presenter. Expression is quiet: worried, puzzled, doubtful, flat. Never a shouting or open-mouth shock face. Always looking at the camera.
channel_findings.text_rules: 2 to 4 words, 2 lines, caps. Line 2 in the red box is the payoff word. Plain speech that states a doubt or a verdict: IT DOESN'T ADD UP, THEY KNEW?, IS IT SAFE?, IT TOOK 50 MINUTES. The thumbnail text never repeats the title; the title carries the place name and the fact, the thumbnail carries the feeling. Biggest line is about 20 to 25 % of frame height.
channel_findings.popular_vs_latest: The channel changed format. The older thumbnails are AI disaster scenes with a fake TV lower-third (SHOCKING / NO WARNING! and a channel 7 or 9 bug) and no host: 21,000 to 196,000 views. The newer ones are the paper explainer with the host: the four best are 1,700,000, 1,200,000, 859,000 and 628,000 views. The channel has 67,400 subscribers, so these are far above its size.
channel_findings.top3: 1 (1,700,000), 11 (1,200,000), 13 (859,000). All three are the paper format with the host and a simple line diagram or map; 1 and 11 put her in the centre with the diagram running behind her; none uses an AI disaster scene.
transfer: One paper ground on every thumbnail (cream graph paper) so the channel is recognised before the words are read: 11 of 11 in the paper format.
Host cut out, head and shoulders, about a third of the frame, quiet worried or doubtful look at the camera, plain top that changes colour: 1, 11, 13, 18, 19.
Two-line headline: black heavy caps, then the payoff word in cream on a red brush box: 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20.

One hand-drawn diagram that shows the mechanism, with one red circle or arrow and one or two pencil labels with a number or a time: 1 (route with 7 MIN 40 and 50 MIN), 20 (timeline 9:00 AM to 7:36 PM), 13 (map dot).
Thumbnail text gives the feeling, the title gives the place and the fact: 13 (IT DOESN'T ADD UP + title names New Madrid), 1 (IT TOOK 50 MINUTES + title names Nepal).
channel_findings.weak: 16 (20,000 views): a grey low-contrast real photo and a one-word headline with no diagram. 20 (30,000) and 15 (54,000): the diagram is small and the question has no number. 2, 5 to 10: fake TV chyron; the storm-market audience audit already banned this look.
